# Stop showing success when browser storage rejects regular edits

## What & Why
Workspace restore now reports when browser storage is unavailable or full, but ordinary profile, answer, and opportunity changes can still appear successful when their local-storage write fails. Users need the same honest feedback for edits so they do not assume changes will survive a reload.

## Done looks like
- Profile, answer, and opportunity saves detect local-storage write failures.
- Success feedback is withheld or replaced with a clear in-memory-only warning.
- The current UI state remains usable while explaining that a reload may lose the change.

## Relevant files
- artifacts/escape-hatch/src/lib/storage.ts
- artifacts/escape-hatch/src/App.tsx
